steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Why Use Unreliable Narration?: • Creates suspense and mystery • Forces reader to question everything • Shows gap between perception and reality • Reveals character through what they hide | Technique + Quotation + Effect = Full Marks: When writing about novel techniques, never just name the method. Every paragraph must identify the technique, quote evidence, and explain the effect on the reader. For AO2, examiners reward analysis of how the writer manipulates narrative to shape meaning — not just what the story is about, but how it is told.
